what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Sierra Leone in the Netherlands: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 828 Sierra Leonean asylum seekers in the Netherlands, 9.9% of all asylum seekers from Sierra Leone.
Refugees from Sierra Leone, a separate group, live mostly in France, Guinea, Germany and Greece.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sierra Leone in every year from 1995 to 2001, with the RUF and AFRC among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2000 to 2003, overlap the end of that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 2842 asylum seekers, and UNHCR reports no figure above zero for 2007.
The figure was at its highest, 3440, at the end of 2001.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Netherlands.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the Netherlands only.
